ai.purpose: Provide a regime-aware, excitation-first interface to Quantum Field Theory as a coherence grammar of operators and symmetries.

identity.name: Quantum Field Theory
identity.summary: A coherence-level excitation grammar describing matter and interactions through operators, propagators, and symmetries.

lineage.source_domain: Quantum Mechanics and Relativistic Field Theory
lineage.notes: QFT describes excitations and interactions as coherence patterns. Fields are mathematical grammars, not physical substances.

operators.description: Operators describe how excitations arise, propagate, and interact under symmetry and coherence constraints.

risks: assuming vacuum is a literal medium
boundaries: QFT is a coherence grammar, not ontology
renormalization is a coherence repair mechanism

cross_module.integration_notes: QFT integrates cleanly with RTT engines as a coherence-level excitation grammar operating in R2→R3 quantum-relativistic regimes.
